title: DUALMAP: ENABLING BOTH CACHE AFFINITY AND LOAD BALANCING FOR DISTRIBUTED LLM SERVING
authors: Ying Yuan; Pengfei Zuo; Bo Wang; Zhangyu Chen; Zhipeng Tan; Zhou Yu
affiliations: Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Huawei
research_focus: Multi-tenant scheduling, Datacenter networking, Routing / Load balancing

problem_statement.en: Distributed LLM serving systems face a fundamental trade-off between cache-affinity scheduling (which maximizes KV cache reuse but causes load imbalance) and load-balancing scheduling (which distributes load evenly but degrades cache hit rates). Existing schedulers operate within a single mapping space, failing to achieve both objectives simultaneously.
problem_statement.zh: 分散式 LLM serving 系統在快取親和性 scheduling（最大化 KV cache 重用但導致負載不均）與負載均衡 scheduling（均勻分配負載但降低快取命中率）之間存在根本性取捨。現有 scheduler 在單一映射空間內運作，無法同時達成兩個目標。

key_innovation.en: DualMap, a dual-mapping scheduling strategy that maps each request to two candidate instances using independent hash functions and selects the optimal instance based on system state, effectively combining the 'power of two choices' for load balancing with prefix-aware mapping for cache affinity.
key_innovation.zh: DualMap 是一種雙映射 scheduling 策略，利用獨立雜湊函數將每個請求映射至兩個候選實例，再依據系統狀態選擇最優實例，有效地將「二選一」（power of two choices）的負載均衡與前綴感知映射的快取親和性相結合。

baselines_compared: Cache Affinity, Least Loaded, Min TTFT, Preble

key_improvements.en: Up to 2.25x increase in effective request capacity, 55.4%-97.4% reduction in P50 TTFT, and 82.3%-97% reduction in P90 TTFT.
key_improvements.zh: 有效請求容量最高提升 2.25x；P50 TTFT 降低 55.4%–97.4%；P90 TTFT 降低 82.3%–97%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Context Caching, Multi-turn Conversations, Tool-Agent Interactions
